answer_1.quote: We introduce Text2Vis, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating LLMs on real-world text-to-visualization tasks … LLMs have demonstrated strong performance in code generation and data analysis …

answer_2.quote: We use GPT-4o as the evaluation judge for all criteria, including Answer Match, Readability, Visualization Quality, and Chart Correctness …

answer_3.quote: We use GPT-4o as the evaluation judge for all criteria … We also included Gemini 1.5 Pro as judge …

answer_4.quote: We manually annotated 236 samples stratified to reflect the full dataset's distribution … The annotations were performed by expert annotators using the same rubric as the automated evaluation.
answer_4.guideline: Human annotators applied the same rubric used for automated evaluation, scoring answer correctness, chart readability, and chart correctness.
